text:
- **Scrolling, selection, tree:** `BaseDocument` scroll API `scroll_to`, `scroll_by`, `scroll_into_view`, `scroll_to_fragment`, `scroll_to_fragment_smooth`, `resolve_scroll_animation`, `scroll_node_by`, `scroll_viewport_by` (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:353-405; packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:551-558; packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:662-668; packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:854-864), plus `get_fragment_target`, `set_viewport_scroll`, `viewport_scroll` and `scroll_into_view(node, ScrollBehavior, ScrollLogicalPosition, ScrollLogicalPosition)` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:97; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:121; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:156; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:203-208; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:308; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:349; tests/blitz-tests/tests/fragment_navigation.rs:230; tests/blitz-tests/tests/paint_tree_incremental.rs:262); `ScrollBehavior` Auto/Instant/Smooth and `ScrollLogicalPosition` Start/Center/End/Nearest (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:11-25); `scroll_into_view` scrolls every scrolling box on its target's containing-block chain, innermost first, and then the viewport — the CSSOM View "scroll an element into view" steps — its signature unchanged and for every caller: script `scrollIntoView`, Dioxus `MountedData::scroll_to`, fragment navigation and the test harness's input helper; a box is scrolled when a programmatic scroll has range in it (`overflow` `scroll`, `auto` or `hidden` on the axis, with overflowing content) and the root element is left to the viewport; a nested box is written at once through `scroll_to(.., ScrollBehavior::Instant)` whatever behaviour was asked — the document holds one scroll animation at a time
 — with no `scroll` event dispatched for it, as for no programmatic scroll (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:570), and the requested behaviour applies to the viewport, whose offset is computed from the target's position after the nested writes; a target whose only scroller is the viewport scrolls as it did (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:655-734; tests/blitz-tests/tests/scroll_into_view_nested.rs:1-10; ratified by the founder, 2026-10-07 — a behaviour change for every document, the method itself widened and no second method added); `visible_region(&self, node_id) -> Option<BoundingRect>` is the read-only reader beside it — the viewport's rect narrowed, on each axis a box clips, to the padding box less the scrollbar size of every box on the element's containing-block chain whose `overflow` on that axis is not `visible`, in viewport-relative CSS pixels with its edges on the 1/64 px grid `get_client_bounding_rect` uses; `None` for a node that does not resolve and when nothing is left; the element's own box is not consulted, and each clipping box is placed where the bounds reader puts it — the box's own position, with no add-back of the box's own scroll offset since 2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit, the region reading as it read before (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:736-796); whether an element can be seen is read from that geometry and never from a hit; the hit walk — `Node::hit` and `hit_inner`, reached through `BaseDocument::hit`, `hit_with_scrollbar` and `element_from_point` — tests a node's own area where the box stands, on the point before the node's scroll offset is added, and a node paint clips
 — either axis of its computed `overflow` not `visible`, or a computed `contain` that includes `paint` on a box paint applies it to (not an inline flow box, not an internal table box other than a cell), the root element excepted, the two axes not told apart: paint's own predicate, the `contain: paint` half ratified by the founder (2026-10-18) — stops the walk at its padding box: for a point outside that box none of its positive-z hoisted children, paint children, negative-z hoisted children or inline content is reached, and the node itself is still answered when the point lies in its border box, while inside the padding box the order, the `visibility` and `pointer-events` rules and the scrollbar-thumb resolution are as they were (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1437-1567; tests/blitz-tests/tests/hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box.rs:187-372 — fixed on the founder's ruling of 2026-10-10, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed by the overseer, how far the stop reaches being the operator's answer of that day; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/report.md); a `contain: paint` box with a `visible` `overflow` stops the hit at its padding box as paint clips it (tests/blitz-tests/tests/hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box.rs:374-400), and its stop at an element's own box is measured since 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep, in both layout modes and both builds: a hit at an `img` holding raster data answers the `img`, a hit inside a block of an `iframe`'s `srcdoc` sub-document answers the `iframe`, the parent's walk not entering the sub-document (pinned as it reads), and a hit inside a filled text `input` answers the `input` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box.rs:431-506);
 a box clipped on one axis (`overflow-x: clip` beside `overflow-y: visible`) stops the hit at its whole padding box, as paint clips it, while `visible_region` narrows such a box on its clipped axis only, so a target lying outside the box along its visible axis reads in view and is not reached by a hit (tests/blitz-tests/tests/hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box.rs:291-314), and a driver `click` on it is refused `covered` with the instance unchanged, in both layout modes — measured at 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep and stated in `covered`'s meaning, neither reader moving on the founder's C5 «Ничего, замерить и записать (Рекомендую)» (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_obstructed.rs:560-605; packages/escher-driver/src/refusal.rs:74-79); a box both transformed and scrolled is hit where its rows show and not through its scrolled-out content — a box under `translate(50px, 30px)` scrolled 280 answers its ninth row where that row shows, and a point inside it where its first row lies unscrolled, beside the narrower row showing there, answers the box, in both layout modes, since 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep (tests/blitz-tests/tests/hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box.rs:531-584); `BaseDocument::get_client_bounding_rect` reads that box where its transform moves it, as CSSOM View's `getBoundingClientRect` does (the client rect under transforms, below); and `Node::absolute_position`, the second position reader, adds the node's own location and hands the sum to the private `position_in_containing_block`, which subtracts its containing block's scroll offset and recurses, so only ancestors' scroll offsets are subtracted — a box at (40, 50) reads (40, 50) at every scroll offset of its own, in both layout modes — and `scroll_into_view` passes `(0.0, 0.0)` where it added the box's scroll back; its callers move with it
 — `handle_dom_event`, `Node::focus`'s IME area, `synthetic_click_event_data`, `scroll_into_view` and the test harness's `layout_rect`, `layout_rect_of` and `center_of`, which read such a box where it stands (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1755-1776; packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:715; tests/blitz-tests/tests/scrolled_box_absolute_position.rs:52-82); the own-box, one-axis and transformed-and-scrolled readings stand as measured; scroll writes dispatch a `scroll` event (packages/blitz-dom/src/scrolling.rs:284-351); public `TextSelection` and `SelectionEndpoint` (packages/blitz-dom/src/selection.rs:14-24; packages/blitz-dom/src/selection.rs:80-86); `NodeTree` `get`, `get_mut`, `contains_key`, `len`, `iter`, `iter_mut`, stale-id indexing panics (packages/blitz-dom/src/tree.rs:75-117; packages/blitz-dom/src/tree.rs:120-136) with "invalid SlotMap key used" (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stale_interaction_state.rs:5-9; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stale_node_mapping.rs:12-16); `TreeTraverser`, `AncestorTraverser` (packages/blitz-dom/src/traversal.rs:46-100); `compare_document_order` (packages/blitz-dom/src/traversal.rs:307-362); `resolve_undisplayed_style` (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:199-241); `resolve_stylist` (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo.rs:70); `resolve_2d_transform` returns `None` for identity (packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_kurbo.rs:25-28; packages/blitz-dom/src/stylo_to_kurbo.rs:124-128); `decode_font_bytes` (packages/blitz-dom/src/util.rs:14-40); `ToColorColor` (packages/blitz-dom/src/util.rs:166-178)

text: - The client rect under transforms (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18): `BaseDocument::get_client_bounding_rect` and `node_client_rects` read an element where its transforms move it — on a containing-block chain that carries a transform (the private `is_transformed_chain`) the private `transformed_bounds` maps the border box's corners through the node's own transform and each containing block's, in device pixels as `hit_inner` and the paint tree map them, the offsets taken from `physical_unrounded_geometry` differences so both of its bodies are served, and reads the axis-aligned bounding box; a non-atomic inline element maps its fragments through the private `transformed_fragment_rects`; with no transform on the chain the reading is the untransformed one in both bodies (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2510-2512; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2521-2530; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2539-2628; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2699-2701; tests/blitz-tests/tests/transformed_client_rect.rs:79-153). `physical_unrounded_geometry`, `offset_rect` (CSSOM `offsetTop`, untransformed), `inline_fragment_rects` and `visible_region` are not edited; the readers of `get_client_bounding_rect` move with it — the snapshot's `bounds`, `node_client_rects`, the events driver's `adjust_element_coords`, the script `getBoundingClientRect` and dioxus-native-dom's `get_client_rect`. A measured limit: `visible_region` places a scrolling box under a transform where it stands untransformed, so a target inside a translated scrolling box reads outside its visible region (tests/blitz-tests/tests/transformed_client_rect.rs:183-220), stated in `off-screen`'s meaning (§Driver session), its fix owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line (target: next).

subject: contract-scrolling-selection-tree
text: - The text extent: `BaseDocument::text_extent(&self, NodeId) -> Option<TextExtent>`, a read-only reader on every document, and `TextExtent { content, text }`, two `BoundingRect`s re-exported from the crate root (packages/blitz-dom/src/text_extent.rs:5-15; packages/blitz-dom/src/text_extent.rs:18-54; packages/blitz-dom/src/lib.rs:111). `content` is the client rect less border, padding and any scrollbar; `text` starts at the content box's top-left, moved down by the inline layout's `block_offset`, and is sized by Parley `Layout::width()` / `height()` over its scale; it reads `None` for an id that does not resolve (`get_node`), a node that is no inline root, or one with no inline layout data. It mutates nothing and has no log site, print, env read or panic path. Its limits: RTL and vertical text are read as LTR horizontal lines, and a transformed box is read at its client rect — each pinned by blitz-tests' `text_extent` in both layout modes (test-plan §1). Its one non-test caller is escher-driver's `Session::lint` (§Driver session).

- **Paint and shell:** `paint_scene(PaintScene, &mut BaseDocument, scale, width, height, x_offset, y_offset)` (packages/blitz-paint/src/lib.rs:43-51; examples/screenshot.rs:120-128; examples/paint_bench.rs:148-156; tests/blitz-tests/tests/background_size.rs:46); blitz-shell re-exports `BlitzApplication`, `BlitzShellEvent`, `BlitzShellProxy`, `View`, `WindowConfig`, `DataUriNetProvider` and winit's `ControlFlow`, `EventLoop`, `EventLoopProxy`, `Window` (packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:20-25; packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:44-45); `BlitzShellEvent` Poll, ResumeReady, RequestRedraw, CloseWindow, Accessibility, Embedder, Navigate, NavigationLoad, ResizeSettleCheck (packages/blitz-shell/src/event.rs:11-62), Embedder/Navigate/NavigationLoad left to embedders (packages/blitz-shell/src/application.rs:93-101); `BlitzShellProxy` pairs a winit proxy with an mpsc Sender and implements `NetWaker` (packages/blitz-shell/src/event.rs:70-103); `View::resume` dispatches ResumeReady and the embedder must call `complete_resume` (packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:291-316; packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:318-362); `BlitzShellProvider` implements `ShellProvider` for redraw, cursor, title, IME, close, minimize, maximize, decorations, drag, clipboard, file dialog (packages/blitz-shell/src/lib.rs:87-219); `DataUriNetProvider` serves only `data` (packages/blitz-shell/src/net.rs:49-69); shell bootstrap `BlitzShellProxy::new(event_loop.create_proxy())`, `BlitzApplication::new(proxy, receiver)`, `WindowConfig::new(Box::new(doc), renderer)`, `add_window`, `event_loop.run_app` (examples/inner_html.rs:25-33; examples/preact_script.rs:25-41);
 since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot a password `input` (its `type` reading `password`) paints its value masked, in every document and through every renderer that paints with blitz-paint, windowed included: `draw_text_input_text` branches to the private `draw_masked_input_text`, which paints a bullet per character laid out by `BaseDocument::layout_as_text_input`, so two values of one length paint byte-identical frames, focused or not; the caret is painted at the bullet of its index in the input's caret colour (private `caret_color`), and the field scrolls only to keep the caret in its content box, measured on the bullets rather than the editor's stored `scroll_offset`; a click inside a field holding a value places the caret by the bullets — blitz-dom's pointer path lays them out through `layout_as_text_input`, scrolled as paint scrolls them, and moves the real editor to the character under the point (§Established Decisions → [Scrolling and input]), so no width of the real characters reaches the caret: one click at one offset into two values of one length lands on one index, and a double click selects the whole value (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs:582-648; tests/blitz-tests/tests/password_caret_click.rs:83-121; packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:912-916; packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:966-973; packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:975-1049; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-12-headless-screenshot/report.md)

subject: contract-test-harness
contract-test-harness
text: - The harness's time (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18): the harness holds a `VirtualClock` its documents share — `HarnessOptions::into_config(self, &VirtualClock)` puts a clone in `DocumentConfig.clock`, so `from_html_with` and `from_vdom`, and through them `from_html` and `from_component`, build documents that read it, while `wrap(doc)` gives the harness a fresh `VirtualClock` and the wrapped document keeps the clock its own config gave it; `time()` reads that clock in seconds and `pump` resolves at it; `tick(dt)` advances it, a negative or non-finite `dt` moving nothing, and `advance_time(&mut self, by: Duration)` advances it by exactly `by`, each then pumping; `screenshot`, `screenshot_rect`, `text_contrast` and `settle` never move it (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/harness.rs:48-76; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/harness.rs:125-133; packages/blitz-test-harness/src/harness.rs:152-174)

subject: contract-headless-stand
text:
- **Headless stand (seven_guis, native only):** `seven_guis::stand` — `LeanTask { Counter, FlightBooker, Timer, Crud }` with `ALL` and `task()`; pinned `VIEWPORT_WIDTH = 800`, `VIEWPORT_HEIGHT = 600`, `HIDPI_SCALE = 1.0`, `COLOR_SCHEME = ColorScheme::Light`; `font_ctx()` = `build_single_font_ctx(DEJAVU_SANS)`, system fonts off; `options(incremental) -> HarnessOptions` with the pinned viewport and bundled font, `net_provider: None` (offline through `DummyNetProvider`) and `base_url: None`, kept `None` for every caller (unit test `the_stand_options_stay_offline`), so every stand boot is offline but `boot_load`'s, which replaces that one field (below); `boot(LeanTask, HarnessOptions) -> Harness<DioxusDocument>` and `boot_timer(HarnessOptions) -> (Harness<DioxusDocument>, TimerTicks)`, each building a fresh `VirtualDom` whose root provides a `TimerTicks` context and renders `app::task_in_shell` with a no-op back handler; and `TIMER_TICK_MS: u32 = 100` with `timer_step(ticks: TimerTicks) -> impl FnMut(&mut Harness<DioxusDocument>, u32)`, the Timer's time step for a driver session (`Session::with_time`, the Driver session contract below): handed the milliseconds asked, it delivers the whole ticks they hold through `TimerTicks::deliver`, carrying the remainder below one tick across calls (250 then 250 deliver 2 then 3 ticks), and returns nothing — the session, not the step, moves the harness's clock (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18); the ticks apply on the next pass (examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:21-129; the time step as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-18-one-virtual-clock/report.md); it installs no telemetry, reads no env var and names no `blitz_net`, its load page's stand-in included.
 Supporting seven_guis API: `app::Task` (pub) and `app::task_in_shell(Task, EventHandler<()>) -> Element`, and `pub fn TaskShell`, the shell a test-local variant of a task mounts in so its unkeyed ids read as the task's (examples/seven_guis/src/app.rs:7; examples/seven_guis/src/app.rs:90; examples/seven_guis/src/app.rs:164); the crate-root `DEJAVU_SANS` woff2 bytes, one `include_bytes!` shared with the wasm entry (examples/seven_guis/src/lib.rs:7; examples/seven_guis/src/lib.rs:17); `tasks::timer::TimerTicks` (`deliver(n)`), which `Timer` reads with `try_use_context` — absent, the 100 ms `futures_timer::Delay` loop; present, one 0.1 s step capped at the duration per delivered tick (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/timer.rs:10-20; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/timer.rs:47-55)

subject: contract-headless-stand
text: - The stand's typography is DejaVu Sans, its one bundled font, stated in this contract and not on design-system's product surface: `font_ctx()` registers it for every generic family with system fonts off, on native; every stand boot holds it through `HarnessOptions.font_ctx`, `boot_cells` and `boot_load` included; and seven_guis' native `woff` feature decodes it (examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:59-61; examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:73; examples/seven_guis/src/lib.rs:7; examples/seven_guis/Cargo.toml:31).

subject: contract-headless-stand
text: - `boot_cells(HarnessOptions) -> Harness<DioxusDocument>` mounts `Task::Cells` in `TaskShell` through the private `cells_root`, Cells staying no `LeanTask`: its screen passes the snapshot text's budget and reads in parts (examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:131-139).

subject: contract-headless-stand
text: - `boot_load(HarnessOptions) -> Harness<DioxusDocument>` mounts a load page in `TaskShell` titled "Load" (the private `load_root` and `LoadPage`, its CSS `.load-root` · `.load-body` · `.load-btn` with `:hover` · `:active` · `.load-done`) holding two keyed elements — `load-fetch`, a Button "Load" in white on the stand accent `#3a5ce5` (hover `#2a4cd3`, active `#1f3fc1`), whose click links the page's one stylesheet, and `load-done`, a Paragraph "Loaded" at `display: none` until that sheet lands, no CSS selecting by id — its options' `net_provider` replaced by `Some(Arc::new(LoadNet))` through `..options`, every other field kept (examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:141-152; examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:177-244).

subject: contract-headless-stand
text: - The private `LoadNet` implements `NetProvider`: each `fetch` answers the fixed `LOADED_CSS` (`.load-body .load-done { display: block; }`) for the fixed `LOAD_URL` `http://stand.test/load.css` from a thread of its own after `pub const LOAD_ANSWER_DELAY: Duration` (200 ms); it overrides no `is_noop`, so the harness counts its load, and holds no `blitz_net`, print, env read, socket or listener — a hand-written network stand-in beside the tests' `HeldNet` and `LateNet`, living in the stand module (examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs:154-175).
